step.cmd: In NWS, add details to the draft SROC created during fact-finding or create a new SROC as follows:

ul.li: Comments: Type “Payment returned — Client not entitled.”

Details: Type “Payment [payment number] issued on [DD-MM-YYYY] for the weeks of [DD-MM-YYYY] to [DD-MM-YYYY] was returned by the client because [client’s reason and details]. Request submitted to IPOC.”

step.cmd: In FTS, determine if there is a registration number for the returned payment issue:

ul.li:
If no, select the Registration Number (M025, M030, M035) transaction and assign a registration number as follows:
Action: Select Assign .
Claim Source: Select 3 - Mail/Revised Decision .
Service Unit: Select 1 .
Decision type: Select 3 - Revised .
Select Update .

step.cmd: Determine if the claim is in MPS or is blocked dormant.
Select the Renewal/Revised (M106) transaction to create an Operational Centre Memo (MM06) as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.

step.cmd: When the Operational Centre Memo (MM06) transaction opens, send the information to IPOC as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.

Work item: Select the appropriate option:
If the claim is active or can be reactivated , select 92 - Purge and Recreate .
If the claim is in MPS or blocked dormant, select 93 - Manual Pay System .

Work type: Select the appropriate option:
If the claim is active or can be reactivated , select 24 - Cancelled payment .
If the claim is in MPS or blocked dormant, select 43 - Cancelled payment .

Remarks line 2: Type “T071-2 [for current year] or T071-8 [for previous year]-reason F-CT [XX]-gross amount [XXXX]-federal tax [XX]-provincial tax (if necessary) [XX]-net amount [XXXX]-PRN [XXXXXXXXXXXX]-Date(s) of processed payments [w/c-start date] — [w/c-end date].”

Remarks line 3 : If any information changed since the original claimant’s report was completed, type “Amend w/c [XXXX] [amount] if required. Add any RTW date if required.” If any disentitlements are applicable type, “Impose D[XX] for w/c [XXXX].”
Remarks line 5: Enter your first name and last name.

step.cmd: Select the Registration Number (M025, M030, M035) transaction and transfer the registration number to IPOC as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.
Registration flag: Select 4 - Insurance Payment Operational Centre .

step.cmd: In NWS, complete the WI for the returned payment issue.
